significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) law that decoded difficulty "should decline monotonically with truncate-and-resume residual work," with overthinking marked by a high plateau after residual work reaches zero, plus the form-(ii) causal claim that steering the implicated heads induces correct termination. This fixes expected within-trace trajectories and an adaptive stopping decision rather than merely showing that difficulty is represented; that matters for the inference-compute allocation decisions studied by Snell et al. (2024) and Muennighoff et al.'s s1 (2025). It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon—persistent reasoning after work is resolved—and a mechanism involving an attention-head-mediated difficulty signal distinguishable from confidence. True and false are determinate, and failure of intermediate decoding, contraction, or confidence-independent steering would rule out this dynamic-difficulty account rather than merely report a missed effect; after topic substitution, efficient mechanistic reasoning alone would not earn this score because the specific contraction law and causal gate provide the additional constraint.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "contraction-failure metric," a step-wise difficulty readout, and the intervention to "steer difficulty heads toward easy" when residual work is low. The online trigger is ex ante with respect to wasted continuation: it flags a solved-but-still-reasoning state and leaves an action window in which decoding can be terminated, although recognizing that state depends on a calibrated residual-work probe. After re-extraction on another model, the claim predicts a transferable relation—difficulty contracts with residual work and stalls during overthinking—not merely the existence of some new direction; its asserted scope covers LLM reasoning traces, and likely downstream users include decoding, inference-serving, and model-auditing practitioners. The topic-substitution check lowers no credit here: generic efficient reasoning supplies neither this forecast nor the concrete stopping intervention, but uncertain robustness beyond the named reasoning-model families keeps the reach below 9.
